# appdynamics_database_collectors (Data Source)

Lists all Database Visibility collectors in the account (account-wide, no inputs).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_database_collectors" "all" {}

output "collector_ids" {
  value = { for c in data.appdynamics_database_collectors.all.collectors : c.id => c.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `collectors` (Attributes List) The collectors in the account (id, type, name, hostname, enabled only; use the singular appdynamics_database_collector data source for full detail on one collector). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))

<a id="nestedatt--collectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collectors`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
